# Stranglethorn Vale rare spawns and drops in WoW Forever

Short answer: Stranglethorn Vale has eight rare spawns on Wowhead Classic, from level 37 to 45. Three of them are worth a real detour: Scale Belly (Iridescent Scale Leggings at 63%), Lord Sakrasis (a scepter and a neck piece at over 40% each) and the Mosh'Ogg Butcher, a rare elite who can drop the Headchopper axe. The other five mostly drop quest items and trade goods, which are handy if you're doing the Booty Bay quests anyway.

This page is the Stranglethorn drill-down from our rare spawns 30–60 guide. For the zone's quest hubs and flight paths see the Stranglethorn Vale zone guide, and for the pirate town's quests see Booty Bay quests. Heading on to the desert next? The Tanaris rare spawns page covers the next zone in the same format.

## Tips from Wowhead commenters

These come from the comments on each rare's Wowhead Classic NPC page. They're player reports from Classic, not Blizzard data.

  * Nimar the Slayer: in 2020 one commenter said he respawns every 5 to 8 hours in Classic. Another said he spawns in the small Witherbark camps and casts what looks like berserking. [Wowhead commenter, Classic; respawn unconfirmed]
  * Foreman Marcrid: a 2005 commenter found him three times at the camp west of the mill, by the dreamfoil in the middle of the camp. He calls for help at half health, so give yourself room. [Wowhead commenter, Classic]
  * Lord Sakrasis: the top-rated comment says he only fights in melee and can be killed at range without taking ranged damage. [Wowhead commenter, Classic]
  * Omgorn the Lost: commenters say he walks round the outer edges of the Eastmoon and Southmoon ruins and the Dunemaul Compound. [Wowhead commenter, Classic]
